newsitem.title: UK: S&P affirms Wuerth Finance senior unsecured at A-.
newsitem.headline: S&P affirms Wuerth Finance senior unsecured at A-.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said on Friday it had affirmed its A minus senior unsecured debt rating of Wuerth Finance International BV based on the guarantee provided by Wuerth, Adolf GmbH & Co.
At the same time, S&P said in a statement it had assigned its A minus corporate credit rating to Wuerth, Adolf GmbH & Co.
"The long-term rating outlook for both units is stable," it said.
"Both ratings reflect the strong industry position of Wuerth as well as its satisfactory financial condition and performance," S&P said.

It said both companies are fully controlled by foundations of the Wuerth family and have strong financial and operational links. Wuerth distributes a range of approximately 40,000 products for assembly, maintenance and repair to firms in the automotive, metal-, wood-working and craft industries.

"Wuerth's trend of gradual expansion to consolidate its leading position within an underdeveloped and fragmented industry should allow for the maintenance of steady earnings growth and cash flow generation in the medium term," S&P said
It said that since Wuerth's customer targets were small- and medium-sized companies, it was in a position to develop a deep service oriented client relationship through its broad salesforce.
"This creates high entry barriers for potential competitors in this highly fragmented and developing market, where Wuerth's competition is limited to small, local operators."

"Deriving the majority of sales from Western Europe, with a historically big share in Germany, Wuerth continues to expand its overseas operations with activities in 52 countries. Due to the small size of its customers, as well as the broad base of suppliers, Wuerth avoids dependence on large customers and the potential concentration of credit risk, as well as reliance on specific suppliers," S&P said.
